Standard WETH9 credits deposits and debits withdrawals with dedicated events; those operations do not emit Transfer. Withdrawal sends native currency to caller. Thus Transfer-only net is not wrapped-token balance change. This repository source is conditional, not proof of deployed runtime.

prestateTracer diffMode reports changed accounts before/after one transaction. disableCode and disableStorage allow compact native balances. Unchanged post fields are omitted; deleted accounts appear only before, newly created only after. It is not a cryptographic proof. Source semantics and provider behavior must be distinguished.

debug_traceTransaction replays the named historical transaction, including required predecessors. Options select tracer, tracerConfig, timeout and reexec. Default state reexecution range128; scope will specify0 to avoid expanding historical regeneration. Provider availability is unknown; no fallback or retry is authorized by this stage.

OnTxStart saves sender, target and block recipient; OnTxEnd compares saved state to final balances/nonces. Unchanged post balance is omitted. Empty prior accounts are removed; deleted accounts lack post entries. Code/storage can be disabled independently. Gas handling is gated empirically by sum of all native deltas equaling negative basefee times receipt gasUsed for this type2 transaction; never subtract sender gas twice. Current source is not provider-client identification.
